headline: Pakistani digital lending platform AdalFi, a Techlogix subsidiary, plans an IPO on the Pakistan Stock Exchange next month to raise up to Rs652 million, Business Recorder reports citing Bloomberg.

card.desc: Company plans to raise up to Rs652 million through new shares.

caption:
Pakistani digital lending platform AdalFi, a Techlogix subsidiary, plans an IPO on the Pakistan Stock Exchange next month, Business Recorder reports citing Bloomberg. It aims to raise up to Rs652 million ($2.35 million) through new shares to expand its Islamic and small-business loan services.
